excerpt: Contribute to henrygabriels/binaural-studio development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
A local-first browser studio for building long-form headphone sessions from binaural tones, music, adaptive textures, and spoken-word audio.

Binaural Studio combines a ten-voice binaural synthesizer with a local music deck, an independent spoken-word deck for audiobooks and other long-form audio, and a real-time master recorder. It can analyse your music in the browser, tune the generated layer to each track, move between state presets during a set, and record the complete result as one audio file. There is no backend, account, build step, or audio upload.

Launch Binaural Studio → — no installation required.

Use stereo headphones and start at a comfortable volume. The state presets are creative sound-design tools, not medical treatments.

What it does

Area Capabilities
Binaural synth Seven state presets, ten independently mixed harmonic pairs, 1–40 Hz beat frequency, adjustable carrier, sine/triangle oscillators, and manual output control
Deck 01 — music Local playlist, whole-track key/BPM/loudness analysis, automatic carrier matching, harmonic sorting, per-track state cues, three-band EQ, and equal-power crossfades
Adaptive layers Slow binaural auto-levelling, impulse texture, filtered air bed, breath modulation, and spatial motion shaped by the current track
Deck 02 — spoken word Local audiobook and spoken-word queue with its own volume, convolution reverb, seek position, ordering, and explicit timed silences
Recording Real-time capture of the complete master mix to M4A/AAC, WebM/Opus, or Ogg/Opus, depending on browser support

You can also use the synthesizer on its own: choose a preset, put on headphones, and press play without loading any files.

Run locally

The app is plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no package dependencies.

git clone https://github.com/henrygabriels/binaural-studio.git
cd binaural-studio
python3 -m http.server 4173

Open http://localhost:4173 in a modern browser. A local server is recommended instead of opening index.html directly.

Build a session

  1. Add music to Deck 01 / Local Set.
  2. Select Analyse Set to estimate key, BPM, loudness, and quiet passages.
  3. Reorder tracks manually or use Sort by Key. Optionally assign a state cue to any track and adjust the crossfade, EQ, or generated layers.
  4. Add an audiobook, podcast, or other spoken-word audio to Deck 02 / Spoken Word. Insert exact pauses, or use Random Gaps to place a 0.5–2.5 second silence between adjacent audio items.
  5. Press the main transport to listen, or Play + Rec Set to rewind both queues and record the session from the beginning.

Recording becomes available after every Deck 01 track has been analysed. The main transport pauses and resumes both decks together.

How the audio is organised

The two user-facing decks are deliberately independent:

  • Deck 01 feeds the music EQ and is the only source used for key, rhythm, loudness, carrier, texture, breathing, state-cue, and crossfade automation.
  • Deck 02 has its own queue, position, volume, reverb, and silence items. It follows the master transport but does not influence the musical analysis.
  • The binaural synth and adaptive layers run on their own Web Audio paths.
  • All four paths meet at the recorded master mix and the headphone output.

This keeps spoken-word playback intelligible and predictable without letting it retune or reshape the music-driven layers.

On-device music analysis

Analysis happens before playback and stays inside the browser:

  • A whole-track chroma profile estimates musical key and reports a confidence score.
  • An onset envelope estimates tempo, pulse confidence, and beat phase.
  • A loudness and quiet-passage map controls slow binaural levelling and places adaptive texture where it is less likely to mask the track.

For a reliable key estimate, the studio selects the analysed root or fifth in a low carrier range and glides there during transitions. Low-confidence results leave the previous carrier in place. These are lightweight musical heuristics, not studio-grade key or loudness measurements, so unusual or harmonically ambiguous material may need manual adjustment.

Automatic crossfades overlap two internal music players for 2–12 seconds. The music level, carrier, beat frequency, harmonic mix, state cue, and generated texture transition across the same window.

Audiobooks and other spoken-word formats

Deck 02 is designed for audiobooks and other long-form spoken audio. It accepts common browser-decodable files including MP3, M4A/AAC, WAV, FLAC, Ogg/Opus, WebM, and M4B. The browser must support the audio codec inside the file; a recognised extension alone does not guarantee playback. DRM-protected audiobook formats such as Audible AAX cannot be decoded by standard browser audio APIs.

Recording and privacy

Play + Rec Set captures music, EQ, crossfades, binaural tones, adaptive layers, spoken-word audio and reverb, and timed silences in real time. It does not use the microphone.

When the File System Access API is available, the app asks for a destination and streams one-second encoded chunks directly to disk. Otherwise it keeps the encoded chunks in memory and starts a download when the set ends. Long sessions therefore use more memory in browsers without direct-to-disk access.

Audio files, decoded samples, analysis results, and recordings remain on your device. The app has no analytics or server-side component. Its only third-party page resources are the UI fonts loaded from Google Fonts.

Current limitations

  • Stereo headphones are required for the intended binaural effect.
  • Sessions and analysis results are not persisted across page reloads.
  • Export is real-time; there is no faster-than-real-time renderer.
  • Playback and recording formats depend on the codecs exposed by the browser.
  • The lightweight key and BPM estimates can be uncertain on sparse, noisy, or harmonically ambiguous audio.

Project structure

index.html  Interface and audio elements
styles.css  Responsive layout and visual system
app.js      Web Audio graph, analysis, sequencing, and recording

Contributions and bug reports are welcome. The project is intentionally dependency-free, so changes should remain usable from a simple static server.

License

MIT

content_html_zh:
本地优先的浏览器工作室，用于根据双耳音调、音乐、自适应纹理和口语音频构建长格式耳机会话。

Binaural Studio 将十声双耳合成器与本地音乐平台、用于有声读物和其他长格式音频的独立口语平台以及实时主录音机结合在一起。 它可以在浏览器中分析您的音乐，将生成的图层调整到每个曲目，在一组期间在状态预设之间移动，并将完整结果记录为一个音频文件。 没有后端、帐户、构建步骤或音频上传。

启动 Binaural Studio → — 无需安装。

使用立体声耳机并以舒适的音量开始。 状态预设是创造性的声音设计工具，而不是医疗治疗。

它的作用

Area 能力
双耳合成器 七种状态预设、十个独立混合谐波对、1–40 Hz 拍频、可调载波、正弦/三角振荡器和手动输出控制
甲板 01 — 音乐 本地播放列表、全轨调性/BPM/响度分析、自动载波匹配、谐波排序、每轨状态提示、三频段均衡器和等功率交叉渐变
自适应层 慢速双耳自动调平、脉冲纹理、过滤气床、呼吸调制以及由当前曲目塑造的空间运动
甲板 02 — 口语 本地有声读物和口语队列，具有自己的音量、卷积混响、搜索位置、排序和明确的定时静音
记录 实时捕获 M4A/AAC、WebM/Opus 或 Ogg/Opus 的完整母带混音，具体取决于浏览器支持

您还可以单独使用合成器：选择预设，戴上耳机，然后按播放键，而无需加载任何文件。

本地运行

该应用程序是纯 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，没有包依赖性。

git clone https://github.com/henrygabriels/binaural-studio.git
cd binaural-studio
python3 -m http.server 4173

在现代浏览器中打开 http://localhost:4173。 建议使用本地服务器，而不是直接打开index.html。

建立一个会话

  1. 将音乐添加到 Deck 01/本地集。
  2. 选择分析集来估计调、BPM、响度和安静段落。
  3. 手动重新排序曲目或使用按键排序。 （可选）为任何轨道分配状态提示并调整交叉淡入淡出、均衡器或生成的图层。
  4. 将有声读物、播客或其他口语音频添加到 Deck 02/口语。 插入精确的暂停，或使用随机间隙在相邻音频项目之间放置 0.5–2.5 秒的静音。
  5. 按主走带键进行收听，或按 Play + Rec Set 倒回两个队列并从头开始录制会话。

分析完 Deck 01 的每首曲目后即可进行录音。 主运输工具同时暂停并恢复两个甲板。

音频是如何组织的

两个面向用户的平台是故意独立的：

  • Deck 01 提供音乐均衡器，是用于调性、节奏、响度、载体、纹理、呼吸、状态提示和交叉淡入淡出自动化的唯一来源。
  • Deck 02 有自己的队列、位置、音量、混响和静音项目。 它遵循主传输但不影响音乐分析。
  • 双耳合成器和自适应层在它们自己的网络音频路径上运行。
  • 所有四个路径在录制的主混音和耳机输出处相遇。

这使得口语播放保持清晰和可预测，而无需重新调整或重塑音乐驱动层。

设备上的音乐分析

分析发生在播放之前并保留在浏览器内：

  • 全轨色度配置文件可估计音乐基调并报告置信度得分。
  • 起始包络估计节奏、脉冲置信度和节拍相位。
  • 响度和安静通道图控制缓慢的双耳调平，并将自适应纹理放置在不太可能掩盖音轨的位置。

为了获得可靠的调估计，工作室会在低载波范围内选择分析的根音或五度音，并在过渡期间在那里滑行。 低置信度结果使之前的运营商保持不变。 这些是轻量级的音乐启发法，而不是录音室级的音调或响度测量，因此不寻常或和声模糊的材料可能需要手动调整。

自动交叉淡入淡出重叠两个内部音乐播放器 2-12 秒。 同一窗口中的音乐电平、载波、拍频、谐波混合、状态提示和生成的纹理过渡。

有声读物和其他口语格式

Deck 02 专为有声读物和其他长格式口语音频而设计。 它接受常见的浏览器可解码文件，包括 MP3、M4A/AAC、WAV、FLAC、Ogg/Opus、WebM 和 M4B。 浏览器必须支持文件内的音频编解码器；仅可识别的扩展名并不能保证播放。 标准浏览器音频 API 无法解码受 DRM 保护的有声读物格式（例如 Audible AAX）。

录音和隐私

Play + Rec Set 实时捕捉音乐、均衡器、交叉淡入淡出、双耳音调、自适应层、口语音频和混响以及定时静音。 它不使用麦克风。

当文件系统访问 API 可用时，应用程序会请求目标并将一秒编码块直接传输到磁盘。 否则，它将编码的块保留在内存中，并在集合结束时开始下载。 因此，长会话会在浏览器中使用更多内存，而无需直接访问磁盘。

音频文件、解码样本、分析结果和录音保留在您的设备上。 该应用程序没有分析或服务器端组件。 它唯一的第三方页面资源是从 Google Fonts 加载的 UI 字体。

目前的限制

  • 需要立体声耳机才能达到预期的双耳效果。
  • 会话和分析结果不会在页面重新加载时保留。
  • 导出实时；没有比实时渲染器更快的了。
  • 播放和录制格式取决于浏览器公开的编解码器。
  • 对于稀疏、嘈杂或谐波模糊的音频，轻量级调和 BPM 估计可能是不确定的。

项目结构

index.html  Interface and audio elements
styles.css  Responsive layout and visual system
app.js      Web Audio graph, analysis, sequencing, and recording

欢迎贡献和错误报告。 该项目有意不依赖任何依赖项，因此更改应该仍然可以从简单的静态服务器使用。
